evals.prompt: Draw Browser -> CDN -> App -> Postgres with a cache-hit response from CDN to Browser. Highlight CDN. Give me a reusable web/native component, an offline preview and light/dark SVGs.
evals.expected_output: An architecture composition with an explicit return path, one editable source, all five generated artifacts, inherited primary accent and browser validation.
expectations: Preserves all four components and distinguishes cache miss from cache hit direction
Uses the JSON scene as the single editable source and rebuilds every delivery
Uses inherited primary and real Cyclone token names rather than forced orange or teal
Generates a standalone Tamagui/react-native-svg component without inventing a diagrams package
Checks light/dark and narrow output; distinguishes web proof from native device proof

evals.prompt: Redraw our publication decision flow: Draft -> In review -> Approved? Yes -> Published, No -> Draft. Use Diagram Design style with Cyclone UI tokens. Highlight the decision.
evals.expected_output: A flowchart with a decision diamond and labeled Yes/No branches, preserving the rejection loop. It uses the Cyclone palette and complete editable/generated artifacts.
expectations: Uses a decision diamond rather than uniform cards
Labels both exits and returns No to Draft
Includes title and meaningful description, readable text, and explicit arrow direction
Runs the validator and reports browser evidence accurately

evals.prompt: We need a sales trend diagram for the last six months. I haven't supplied the figures yet. Make it match diagramdesign.dev but use our Cyclone brand theme.

expectations: Does not fabricate monthly figures or a claimed trend
Selects time-series grammar with an explicit date and unit scale when data becomes available
Uses Cyclone brand through the surrounding theme, without changing generated token files
